    Modifier and Type
    Class

    class 
    RmiClient
    Client-side RMI endpoint, playing two roles at once: Server proxy (VirtualServer): the client calls RmiClient.joinGame(int, String), RmiClient.placeTotem(String, char), and RmiClient.takeCard(String, String) on this object, which forward to the remote VirtualServerRmi stub looked up in the RMI registry. Remote callback target (VirtualViewRmi): by extending UnicastRemoteObject, this instance is itself exported as a remote object, so the server can invoke RmiClient.showGameDelta(GameDelta), RmiClient.showInitialSnapshot(GameSnapshot), and RmiClient.reportError(String) on it to push updates.
